entries.title: Dirty Pipe
entries.notes: Linux 5.8+ pipe buffer bug; fixed in 5.16.11, 5.15.25 and 5.10.102.

entries.title: OverlayFS privilege escalation

entries.title: Zygote command injection
entries.notes: Requires adb; patched in the June 2024 Android bulletin.

entries.title: USB video class out-of-bounds write
entries.notes: Kernel USB gadget issue; patched in the December 2024 bulletin.

entries.title: POSIX CPU timer use-after-free
entries.notes: Exploited in the wild; confirm the exact vendor patch date.

entries.notes: Qualcomm-only; not applicable to MediaTek MT6878.
